SELECT f.channel_id, o.status, o.fulfilment_type, o.login_state, count(*) n, count(DISTINCT f.receipt_id) orders, sum(f.net_amount) net, sum(f.gross_amount) gross, min(f.sale_date) mn, max(f.sale_date) mx, sum(CASE WHEN o.web_order_id IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) no_order
FROM fact_sales_line f LEFT JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id

WITH w AS (
 SELECT p.sku, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p USING(product_key)
 WHERE f.channel_id IN (2,3) AND f.sale_date>=DATE '2025-11-03'),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qr FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1),
a AS (SELECT w.sku, sum(w.net_amount) gross_net, sum(w.quantity) units, coalesce(sum(r.refund_net),0) refunds, coalesce(sum(r.qr),0) qret
 FROM w LEFT JOIN r USING(sales_line_id) GROUP BY 1)
SELECT a.*, a.gross_net-a.refunds net_after_returns, rank() OVER (ORDER BY gross_net DESC) rk_gross, rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.gross_net-a.refunds DESC) rk_net,
 (SELECT product_name FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku AND d.is_current LIMIT 1) nm, (SELECT category FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku=a.sku AND d.is_current LIMIT 1) cat
FROM a ORDER BY 6 DESC LIMIT 15

calls.statement:
WITH w AS (
  SELECT p.sku, f.sales_line_id, f.net_amount, f.quantity
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
  WHERE f.channel_id IN (2, 3) AND f.sale_date >= DATE '2025-11-03'),
r AS (SELECT sales_line_id, sum(refund_net) refund_net, sum(quantity_returned) qty_returned FROM fact_return_line GROUP BY 1),
a AS (SELECT w.sku, sum(w.net_amount) - coalesce(sum(r.refund_net), 0) AS web_net_sales,
             sum(w.quantity) - coalesce(sum(r.qty_returned), 0) AS net_units
      FROM w LEFT JOIN r ON r.sales_line_id = w.sales_line_id GROUP BY 1)
SELECT rank() OVER (ORDER BY a.web_net_sales DESC) AS rank, a.sku, cur.product_name, cur.category, a.web_net_sales, a.net_units,
  (SELECT count(DISTINCT product_name) FROM dim_product d WHERE d.sku = a.sku) n_names
FROM a JOIN dim_product cur ON cur.sku = a.sku AND cur.is_current
ORDER BY a.web_net_sales DESC LIMIT 10
